Captured from /private/tmp/beta8-task-8-before/backend/src/audio_memory/analysis/beta8_search.py
Original full-file SHA-256: b8f8fe2c624492a37386bdda63caac595881544d8d47edca817781bc9a9432dc

The policy-bearing source behavior was:

for task in tasks:
    existing = completed.get(task.search_task_key)
    if existing is not None:
        packets.append(existing)
        continue
    packet = await self._execute_one(task)
    await persist(packet)
    packets.append(packet)

outcome = await self.provider.native_search(
    self.provider_id,
    queries=[task.question],
    round_number=1,
    model_id=self.model_id,
)

This binds input task order, exactly one round-1 provider request per unfinished
task, and zero provider requests for an empty task list. Task 8's permitted URL
canonicalization/source-ID/strict-closure changes are intentionally outside this
policy projection.
